# Kernethar Grimwitch, Fugitive Sorcerer

*Pages PDF 124-125*

## **Kheitalla as Nemesis**
If Characters interfere with the steady flow of sacrifices, they become the death hag’s enemy. If they free captives bound for Khaine’s temple or hamper raids, they offend Khaine and threaten her vanity. Should the blood cease flowing, Kheitalla’s true, wizened appearance will be revealed and she will feel the touch of mortality — something she cannot endure. 

## **Kernethar Grimwitch, Fugitive Sorcerer**
_’Prophecies be damned! I just want to be left to do my research!’_ 

— Kernethar Grimwitch in a moment of frustration 

## **Motivation:** Fear of Capture and Death
If the Characters are protected by the sorceresses, Kheitalla might contrive their murder, as she is contemptuous of magic users in general and distrusts their machinations.

**Short-term ambition:** Stay away from dark elves and avoid scrutiny 

**Long-term ambition:** Discover new ways to shape _Ghur_ , _Dhar_ , and _Shyish_ 

According to the Prophecy of Demise, Malerion need fear only the son of a noble house who is a master of both magic and beasts. Convinced this could mean his doom, he orders the massacre of all males who can work magic. Kernethar Grimwitch, warlock and firstborn son of the drachau of Clar Karond, knows the Prophecy of Demise well, which is why he runs for his life. 

The offspring of an affair between the drachau and a witch elf, Kernethar displayed a genius for magic from birth. Knowing discovery would mean the death of his son and his whole house, the drachau instructed the mother to spirit away the child to the temple of Khaine, where he would be raised as a nameless menial away from Malerion’s grasp. 

And yet his mother could not suppress her son’s instinctive sorcerous tendencies. Kernethar secretly mastered _Shyish_ and _Ghur_ and studied dark magic. He also learned alchemy and medicine to serve the temple, which provided him a cover for his own research into his driving passion, to investigate the interaction of the winds of magic with the nature of life and death, the bestial and civilised mind. 

Inevitably, Malerion learned the truth, there was a bloody purge in Clar Karond, and Kernethar escaped only hours before the black guard raided the temple of Khaine. Hiding his sorcery, he made his way to _Temple of Spite_ and took service on as a soldier. For a time he was safe, but paranoia seized his mind and he used magic to murder a suspicious highborn. Fearing discovery, he sailed with corsairs headed for the Empire’s coast, where he slipped away and adopted a high elf disguise. 

## **Trappings**
Brass Crown of Office, Blood-stained Robes, Two Swords, Ceremonial Dagger, Main Gauche, Vials of Witchbrew (5) and Black Lotus (5) 

Patrons and nemeses 

For ten years, he has travelled the Old World’s roads masquerading as Malforic Silverblade, a fencing master from Lothern. If he can sneak past the notice of elves who may know better, he is able to use his forged testimonials to make a fine living teaching the scions of the nobility and wealthy merchants the gentlemanly arts of self-defence. By no means a master by Druchii standards, the allure of having an elven teacher fools many, and he moves on before too many question his skills. 

Kernethar Grimwitch is a Druchii in early middle age, tall even for his people, with raven black hair worn long and tied back when fencing or working magic. He favors leathers of dark brown and black, befitting his cover, and wields a fine rapier and dagger in a two-handed style. Hidden in secret compartments of his travelling trunks are ceremonial robes for magical work, an Arabyan jewelled scimitar, and his diary and grimoire. The diary is his most closely-guarded possession, the only place where he captures his true thoughts. 

Though beautiful, his dark brown eyes betray no emotion, for he conceals his feelings with perfect discipline. Calloused by his time in the temple, Grimwitch learned to quash the emotions he feels in order to maintain his cover and focus on any potential threats. To recklessly express anger, sadness, hatred, or even enthusiasm for magical investigation, risks his life. 

For life in Naggaroth and on the run has taught Kernethar one feeling — paranoia. A deep-seated worry that agents of Malerion are everywhere. Thus he never stays in one place too long, leaving after a few weeks for a new city far away. His travels have taken him from Magritta to Erengrad. Fearful of Druchii hunters, he never travels by sea.
